name: usage-meter
title: Usage Meter
description: A labelled thin meter for quotas such as an AI allowance: label, percent, bar and an optional reset time. Turns yellow and then red as it fills.
usage:
<UsageMeter label="5-hour window" value={32} reset="Resets at 3:40 pm" />

<UsageMeterGroup aria-label="AI allowance">
  <UsageMeterGroupLabel>AI allowance</UsageMeterGroupLabel>
  <UsageMeter size="compact" label="5-hour" value={32} />
  <UsageMeter size="compact" label="Week" value={18} />
</UsageMeterGroup>
notes: value is the amount used, out of max (100 by default). The percent is rounded and read out by screen readers as "32% used". The bar turns yellow at warnAt (75) and red at dangerAt (90).
size="compact" is the 88px meter used in top bars; it hides the reset line. UsageMeterGroup wraps compact meters in the bordered allowance chip. Give it an aria-label, since it has role="group".
